summary: New Scaleway Business customers can receive a €100 ex-VAT free-credit voucher for Scaleway services. The voucher is emailed within 24 hours and must be activated once in the console; credits then remain valid for 30 days. A valid payment method is required, and anyone previously invoiced by Scaleway, even €0, is ineligible. Usage beyond the allowance is billed at public prices; unused expired credits cannot be refunded or reallocated. The enrollment offer has no stated global end date.
claim_steps: Create a new Business account at https://www.scaleway.com/en/signup-trial/ with a valid payment method; you must never have received a Scaleway invoice, including a €0 invoice.
Redeem the €100 ex-VAT voucher emailed within 24 hours in the client console. It can be activated only once, subject to Scaleway terms.
Use the credits within 30 days after activation. Monitor resources and billing: additional usage is charged, and unused expired credits are forfeited.

social_proof.title: Scaleway Business signup trial
social_proof.text: Get started with €100 free credit when you create a Business account. New Business customers with a valid payment method are eligible; you must never have had an invoice (even €0). Credits exclude VAT and are valid 30 days once activated; the voucher can only be activated once.
